basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Technician Clinical Pharmacology is on Tuesday, 27 October 2026. Candidates report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. at Meeting Room-2, at Khanolkar Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210. The hiring company is A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., a private outsourced contractor for manpower services. It will place the selected Technician on contract at Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, under Advt- OS-A/130/2026 dated 14 October 2026. The consolidated salary is ₹ 26,210 to 35,000/- p.m.

content_sections.heading: About ACTREC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC (TMC-ACTREC) is in Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. The Technician will work there on contract but will be hired by A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. The notice calls this company an outsourced contractor for manpower services. This is not a regular appointment with Tata Memorial Centre itself.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice is for one post, Technician Clinical Pharmacology. The post is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. The notice prints the essential qualification and experience as follows: B.Sc. (MLT), OR B.Sc. with D.M.L.T., OR M.Sc/ M pharm. The notice continues: "with minimum 1-year experience in Hospital or Handling HPLC instrument preferable." The age limit is up to 30 years. The notice says this "may be relaxed on experience basis". The notice does not give a date on which age is counted. The consolidated salary is ₹ 26,210 to 35,000/- p.m. Where a candidate falls in this range depends on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria. The contract is for 6 months, extendable as per requirement. For the exact eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification. faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Technician Clinical Pharmacology?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Tuesday, 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. at Meeting Room-2, at Khanolkar Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: The site counts 1 vacancy, because the notice advertises one post, Technician Clinical Pharmacology, without printing a number.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the Technician Clinical Pharmacology post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is B.Sc. (MLT) OR B.Sc. with D.M.L.T. OR M.Sc/ M pharm. The notice adds: "with minimum 1-year experience in Hospital or Handling HPLC instrument preferable."

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 30 years, and the notice says it may be relaxed on experience basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Technician Clinical Pharmacology post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is ₹ 26,210 to 35,000/- p.m. The amount depends on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring their Bio-data and a recent passport size photograph. They should also bring scanned copies of their Aadhar Card and PAN CARD, plus the ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Technician Clinical Pharmacology job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., an outsourced contractor for manpower services. The contract is for 6 months and can be extended as per requirement.

faq.question: Q9. How is the candidate selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview at TMC-ACTREC, Kharghar, on 27 October 2026.
